references.text: The same ritual performed with the blood of the guilt offering on the right earlobe, right thumb, and right big toe during the cleansing of a person with leprosy.
At the consecration of Aaron and his sons, the blood was applied in the same way to the right earlobe, right thumb, and right big toe.
During priestly consecration, the blood was smeared on the right earlobe, right thumb, and right big toe, following the same pattern as in the cleansing ritual.
Describes the guilt offering (אָשָׁם) and how it is to be slaughtered, which is the same type of sacrifice mentioned here.
Basic regulations concerning the guilt offering used in the cleansing ritual.
